I kindly request your guidance on the following:

How I can access and submit the eligibility form required for the viva sessions, and

Whether my course status can be corrected, or if there are any additional steps I need to follow in order to proceed with this year’s training session.

Your support and guidance in this matter would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you very much for your time and understanding.




Best regards,

Fathima Chamha

updates.author: Prof.(Ms) U.W. Ratnayake 18 May 2026
updates.content:
Those who have given request letters to add EEY4489, please find a project for you to do. EEY4489 is not a group project but an individual project.

This course requires you to spend 400 hours for this project.

To start the journey, first you must find a problem to solve and do a background research. Next step is to present your project proposal to an evaluation panel. If your project proposal is not approved, next step should be to 'Drop' the course without continuing and making the course 'repeat'.
